description: Removes a remembered preference (id, from resume_session profile), or resets the observed habits (observed=true), or everything HexaCore knows about how the user works (all=true). Use when the user asks you to forget something or a preference is outdated.

agent.description: The agent role making this call (e.g. "dev", "qa", "e2e"), so its work is attributed to it. Defaults to HEXACORE_AGENT.

name: forget_preference
title: Forget user preferences
